# awscc_devopsagent_asset (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::DevOpsAgent::Asset. An asset attached to an existing AWS DevOps Agent Space. Customer-creatable types include skill, agents_md, and attachment; call ListAssetTypes for the current authoritative set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the parent Agent Space. The asset is created as a child of this agent space.
- `asset_type` (String) The type of asset. The Asset API treats this as an open string; call ListAssetTypes for the current authoritative set of supported types. As of launch, customer-creatable types include skill, agents_md, and attachment.

### Optional

- `files` (Attributes List) Inline file list. Mutually exclusive with Zip; enforced by the handler at Create/Update time. Write-only: not repopulated by Read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `metadata` (String) Asset metadata document. Required and optional keys depend on AssetType. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or lists of any of those - validated server-side; see the public Asset API docs for the per-type metadata schema.
- `zip` (String) Base64-encoded zip bundle containing all files for the asset. Mutually exclusive with Files; enforced by the handler at Create/Update time. Write-only: not repopulated by Read. Server treats a zip as 'replace all files' (max 6 MiB).

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the asset. Nested under the parent Agent Space: arn:<partition>:aidevops:<region>:<account-id>:agentspace/<agentspace-id>/asset/<asset-id>.
- `asset_id` (String) The unique identifier of the asset (assigned by the service on Create).
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the asset was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the asset was last updated.
- `version` (Number) The current asset version. Server-managed; bumps on every successful Update (including no-op updates). This is the drift signal for change detection.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Optional:

- `content_bytes` (String) Base64-encoded binary contents of the file. Mutually exclusive with ContentText (max 6 MiB).
- `content_text` (String) UTF-8 text contents of the file. Mutually exclusive with ContentBytes (max 1.5 MiB).
- `metadata` (String) Per-file metadata document. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or lists of any of those (validated server-side).
- `path` (String) Path of this file within the asset bundle.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_devopsagent_asset.example
  identity = {
    agent_space_id = "agent_space_id"
    asset_id       = "asset_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `agent_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the parent Agent Space
- `asset_id` (String) The unique identifier of the asset (assigned by the service on Create)

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_devopsagent_asset.example
  id = "agent_space_id|asset_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_devopsagent_asset.example "agent_space_id|asset_id"
```
